QUOTE: "`run_async_ask` worker | `external_bridge.cpp:1158` | **Detached** (l.1222)" and "`run_async_ask` captures `this` and is never joined. `stop()` joins the accept and client threads but not this one, so an in-flight ask could outlive the bridge."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the async-ask worker as the one detached thread (the "one exception") and says it is never joined and can outlive the bridge.
